en.title: DAA 3.9.1(2) and 3.8.4(2): permission to combine items '(f) and (j)' copied from COB Schedule 3 after relettering
en.summary: In COB Schedule 3 (source text) (f) is the price and (j) the firm's charges, so combining them gives an all-in price. DAA 3.9.1 drops COB item (c) (client's name), so the price is (e) and the charges (i); yet 3.9.1(2) still says '(f) and (j)' - now the execution-only statement and amounts received from another Person, which cannot form a single price. DAA 3.8.4 drops three COB items (principal/agent, client name, total payable) and ends at (i): '(j)' does not exist there at all (and the paragraph is numbered (2) without a (1)).
en.correction: Please read "items (e) and (i)" for "items (f) and (j)" in 3.9.1(2) and "items (d) and (g)" in 3.8.4(2), and number the lead-in of 3.8.4 as (1).

quotes.source: AIFC Rules on Digital Asset Activities_V5 (with amendments as of 7 December 2025, which commence on 1 January 2026)
quotes.text: (e) the price or unit price at which the Transaction was executed;

quotes.source: AIFC Rules on Digital Asset Activities_V5 (with amendments as of 7 December 2025, which commence on 1 January 2026)
quotes.text: (f) if applicable, a statement that the Transaction was executed on an execution-only basis;

quotes.source: AIFC Rules on Digital Asset Activities_V5 (with amendments as of 7 December 2025, which commence on 1 January 2026)
quotes.text: (j) the amount or basis of any amounts received from another Person in connection with the services.

quotes.source: AIFC Rules on Digital Asset Activities_V5 (with amendments as of 7 December 2025, which commence on 1 January 2026)
quotes.locator: DAA V5, 3.8.4(2) and 3.9.1(2) (same sentence, pp.67 and 68)
quotes.text: A Digital Asset Service Provider may combine items (f) and (j) above in respect of a Transaction where the Client has requested a note showing a single price combining both of these items.

quotes.source: AIFC Rules on Digital Asset Activities_V5 (with amendments as of 7 December 2025, which commence on 1 January 2026)
quotes.locator: DAA V5, 3.8.4(i) - last item of the list
quotes.text: (i) a statement that the price at which the Transaction has been Executed is on a Historic Price or Forward Price basis, as the case may be.
